acks.note: Done for every Short, no test: the narrator now speaks at 1.0 instead of 0.92 (about 164 words a minute, up from 151), and writers count words at that pace.

The topic feed now ranks a topic whose reference video is rising this month higher (by its views a day, up to +1 point; references over 90 days old add nothing), so the planner takes what is gaining traction first.

Long videos now zoom only when the line needs it: that video changed shot size every 1.3 s, so lint and the render fail a long video changing size more than once every 5 s on average or zooming in and straight back out more than 3 times (renderer/craft.py, director.md). For Shorts it is the next look test on this channel's weekly loop (tech-calm-camera, top of the look list).
The long_story README and the checklist now say a long hook shows the everyday thing first (the phone, then its chip, then the machine), each on its word; Studio writes the next hooks that way.
